about_the_game:
Consume. Grow. Dominate.

In Omnos: The Endless Journey, you play as an exotic particle from beyond this universe, driven by an insatiable hunger. Starting as a tiny speck of energy, your only goal is to absorb matter, grow stronger, and unlock new bonuses as you consume everything in your path.

Inspired by classic arcade-style growth games, Omnos blends fast-paced action, minimalist visuals, and cosmic-scale evolution into an addictive game-play loop.

Core Game-play

Start Small, Grow Big. Begin as a small particle and grow by consuming other particles and entities.

Evolve with Unique Abilities

As you grow, unlock a variety of boosts such as moving faster, or even alter the laws of space to your advantage.

Lose Yourself in the Flow

With intuitive and simple controls, ambient audio, a relaxing soundtrack, and minimalist approach, Omnos delivers a zen-like intensity that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down.

Key Features

Arcade-style level-up game-play with quick, satisfying progression

Looping growth mechanic—absorb, evolve, repeat

Level-up bonuses that affect your game-play

Relaxing music for that 5-minute break you need

Minimalist controls (keyboard/mouse)

Comprehensive user manual bundled with the game
